_source.note: CMD_SEND_CHANNEL_DATA (0x3E) layouts from examples/companion_radio/MyMesh.cpp, handler 'CMD_SEND_CHANNEL_DATA' at the pin: [3E][channel_idx][path_len][path][data_type u16 LE][blob]. path_len 0xFF means flood and carries no path bytes (OUT_PATH_UNKNOWN, src/helpers/ContactInfo.h:6). The path byte packs hops in the low six bits and hash-size minus one in the top two (src/Packet.cpp:20-30). data_type 0x0000 is DATA_TYPE_RESERVED and is refused (src/helpers/TxtDataHelpers.h:9).
_source.blob_budget: MAX_GROUP_DATA_LENGTH (165) minus the 3-byte inner type/length header = 162 (src/MeshCore.h:21, BaseChatMesh.cpp:518-522); the frame is 5 + path + blob, at most MAX_FRAME_SIZE (176).
